0.kurzbeschreibung: The Achensee is Tirol’s largest lake—turquoise-blue waters framed by steep mountain slopes, famous as the "Sea of the Alps".

1.name: Arlberg
1.kurzbeschreibung: The Arlberg is the cradle of alpine skiing – legendary downhill runs, luxurious mountain villages, and untouched nature at over 2,800 meters elevation.

2.name: Außerfern
2.kurzbeschreibung: The Außerfern is the northwesternmost region of Tirol – a landscape of lakes and mountains with views of the Zugspitze, the wild Lech river, and picturesque villages.

3.name: Imst & Surroundings
3.kurzbeschreibung: Imst is the gateway to the Ötztaler Alpen – a city steeped in tradition, vibrant with Fasching celebrations, and brimming with alpine charm.

4.name: Innsbruck
4.kurzbeschreibung: Innsbruck – the Alpine metropolis with the world-famous Golden Roof, surrounded by mighty peaks and situated directly on the Inn River.

5.name: Kaunertal
5.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaunertal is Tirol’s quiet side – a high valley with a glacier ski area, deep gorges, and authentic alpine farming.

6.name: Kitzbühel
6.kurzbeschreibung: Kitzbühel – the legendary sports town in Tirol, famous for the Hahnenkamm-Rennen and surrounded by the Kitzbüheler Alpen.

7.name: Kufstein & Wilder Kaiser
7.kurzbeschreibung: Kufstein and the Wilde Kaiser – one of Tirol’s most stunning mountain backdrops, featuring the fortress of Kufstein and the majestic Kaisergebirge.

8.name: Landeck & Paznaun
8.kurzbeschreibung: Landeck and the Paznaun Valley – where the mountains stretch wider and the Oberinntal opens up into a grand alpine world.

9.name: Ötztal
9.kurzbeschreibung: The Ötztal is Tirol’s longest side valley—a realm of superlatives featuring mighty glaciers, the 3,768 m high Wildspitze, World Cup hub Sölden, and alpine wellness at Aqua Dome.

10.name: East Tyrol
10.kurzbeschreibung: East Tyrol is a sun-drenched alpine paradise between the majestic Hohe Tauern range with Mount Grossglockner and the rugged Lienz Dolomites.

11.name: Stubai Valley

13.name: Zillertal

1369.kurzbeschreibung: Burgruine Vilsegg near Vils in the Außerfern: built around 1220 by the Herren von Hohenegg, significant Hohenstaufen hilltop castle with 17 m high rusticated ashlar keep.

1370.name: Burg Wiesberg
1370.kurzbeschreibung: Burg Wiesberg in Tobadill: Defiant 13th-century hilltop castle, perched spectacularly above the Trisanna gorge and the 87-metre-high Arlberg railway viaduct.

1371.name: Burgenwelt Ehrenberg
1371.kurzbeschreibung: Burgenwelt Ehrenberg near Reutte enchants as a monumental fortress complex featuring an interactive knight museum, castle ruins, and alpine scenery.

1372.name: Burgruine Ehrenberg
1372.kurzbeschreibung: The Ehrenberg Castle ruins near Reutte tower as a 13th-century hilltop stronghold, standing as the historic centrepiece of the Burgenwelt ensemble.

1373.name: Burgruine Schrofenstein
1373.kurzbeschreibung: The daring Schrofenstein Castle ruins near Stanz and Landeck cling dramatically to a vertical cliff face high above the Inn Valley.

1374.name: Burgruine Thaur
1374.kurzbeschreibung: The Burgruine Thaur and the Romedikirchl near Hall in Tirol: once a 12th-century stronghold of the Counts of Andechs, hermitage of St. Romedius, and open-air stage.

1375.name: Chasa Retica Spiss
1375.kurzbeschreibung: Chasa Retica in Spiss: Rhaeto-Romanic cultural museum in Austria's highest municipality at 1,653 m above sea level on the border with the Engadin.

1376.name: Defereggental
1376.kurzbeschreibung: The pristine Defereggen Valley in East Tyrol enchants as an unspoiled alpine sanctuary in the Hohe Tauern National Park with ancient stone pine forests.

1377.name: Dom zu St. Jakob Innsbruck
1377.kurzbeschreibung: The baroque Dom zu St. Jakob in Innsbruck: built 1717–1724 by Johann Jakob Herkomer, Asam ceiling frescoes, Cranach's Mariahilf painting, and 48-bell carillon.

1378.name: Ehrwalder Alm
1378.kurzbeschreibung: The Ehrwalder Alm at 1,500 m at the foot of the Zugspitze: modern 8-seater gondola, barrier-free Tirolerhaus, and the gateway to Seebensee and Drachensee.

1379.name: Engalm
1379.kurzbeschreibung: The historic Engalm village at the Great Sycamore Plain (Großer Ahornboden) in the Karwendel is Tyrol's oldest active mountain pasture village.

1380.name: ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal Mayrhofen
1380.kurzbeschreibung: ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal in Mayrhofen: 6,000 m² show dairy, show farm with animals, and tastings of Zillertal hay milk specialties.

1381.name: Erlebnisberg Achensee
1381.kurzbeschreibung: Erlebnisberg Rofan at Lake Achensee: Rofanseilbahn cable car to 1,840 m, spectacular AIRROFAN skyglider, Adlerhorst viewing platform, and a climbing paradise.

1382.name: Erlebnispark Hög Serfaus
1382.kurzbeschreibung: Erlebnispark Hög in Serfaus at 1,820 m: idyllic Högsee with boats, Schneisenfeger family coaster, woodcutter area, and family recreation.

1383.name: Erlebnistherme Zillertal
1383.kurzbeschreibung: The Erlebnistherme Zillertal in Fügen offers vibrant aquatic fun, thrilling water slides, and a generous wellness and sauna world for the entire family.

1384.name: Fasnachtshaus Nassereith
1384.kurzbeschreibung: The Fasnachtshaus in Nassereith: award-winning heritage museum dedicated to the Schellerlaufen carnival with over 400 artistic wooden masks crafted by master woodcarvers.

1385.name: Felixé Minas Haus Tannheim
1385.kurzbeschreibung: The Felixé Minas Haus in Tannheim: a 300-year-old heritage town house showcasing authentic Baroque and Biedermeier living culture in the Tannheimer Tal.

1386.name: Fernpass
1386.kurzbeschreibung: The Fern Pass at 1,216 metres is a storied alpine mountain pass between Reutte and Imst, celebrated for its Zugspitze panoramas, Lake Blindsee, and Roman history.

1387.name: Festung Kufstein
1387.kurzbeschreibung: Festung Kufstein crowns a 90-metre rock above the River Inn featuring the Kaiserturm, Heroes’ Organ, rock tunnels, and the Kaiser Maximilian panorama funicular.

1388.name: Festung Nauders
1388.kurzbeschreibung: Festung Nauders on the Reschenpass: monumental five-storey Habsburg road barricade from 1840, carved deep into the rock with a Kaiserschützen museum.

1389.name: FeuerWerk HolzErlebnisWelt Fügen
1389.kurzbeschreibung: FeuerWerk in Fügen in the Zillertal: Europe's most modern BioMasseHeizKraftWerk by the Binderholz Group featuring HolzErlebnisWelt, a sculpture garden, and roof terrace.

1390.name: Fisser Sonnenterrasse
1390.kurzbeschreibung: The Fiss Sun Terrace at 1,436 metres in the Upper Inn Valley is Tirol's sunniest high plateau, boasting 2,000 sunshine hours, panoramic vistas, and family alpine parks.

1391.name: Flexenpass
1391.kurzbeschreibung: The 1,773 m high Flexenpass links Tyrol and Vorarlberg with historic rock galleries, steep gorges, and sweeping alpine vistas.

1392.name: Franziskanerkloster Schwaz
1392.kurzbeschreibung: Endowed in 1507 by Maximilian I., Franziskanerkloster Schwaz houses a world-famous Gothic cloister featuring 22 monumental passion frescoes.

1393.name: Gaistal Leutasch
1393.kurzbeschreibung: The Gaistal near Leutasch above 1,200 m: pristine alpine pasture paradise between Wetterstein and Mieminger Kette, Ganghoferweg, and Igelsee.

1394.name: Galerie im Alten Rathaus
1394.kurzbeschreibung: Museum Kitzbühel / Sammlung Alfons Walde at Hinterstadt 32 features 60 original Walde paintings, mining history, and a panoramic rooftop terrace.

1395.name: Galitzenklamm
1395.kurzbeschreibung: Galitzenklamm gorge near Lienz in East Tirol is a thundering natural ravine nestled at the foot of the Lienz Dolomites, featuring footbridges, via ferratas, and a forest park.

1396.name: Geierwally Freilichtbühne Elbigenalp
1396.kurzbeschreibung: The Geierwally-Freilichtbühne in Elbigenalp: spectacular open-air theater stage in the wild Bernhardstalschlucht in honor of Anna Stainer-Knittel.

1397.name: Gerlossteinbahn
1397.kurzbeschreibung: The Gerlossteinbahn cable car at Hainzenberg in the Zillertal ascends to the sunny Gerlosstein plateau at 1,644 metres, featuring alpine meadows and the Almflieger zipline.

1398.name: Gleirschklamm
1398.kurzbeschreibung: Gleirschklamm near Scharnitz in Naturpark Karwendel: pristine gorge trail along the roaring Gleirschbach with wooden walkways and timber floating history.

1399.name: Gletscherweg Kaunertal
1399.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaunertal Glacier Trail in the rear Kaunertal is a gripping high-alpine educational trail at Gepatschferner glacier above 1,900 m, showcasing moraines and glacial geology.

1400.name: Glungezer
1400.kurzbeschreibung: The Glungezer at 2,677 m near Tulfes: panoramic mountain in the Tux Prealps with a 10-seater gondola, Kugelwald am Glungezer, and Zirbenweg.

1401.name: Goldenes Dachl
1401.kurzbeschreibung: The Goldenes Dachl in Innsbruck's old town is Tyrol's iconic landmark: 2,657 fire-gilded copper shingles, Moriskentänzer reliefs, and a Maximilian museum.

1402.name: Grawa-Wasserfall
1402.kurzbeschreibung: The Grawa-Wasserfall in Neustift im Stubaital: at 85 m the widest waterfall in the Eastern Alps, 180 m drop, WildeWasserWeg and healing spray inhalation.

1403.name: Greifvogelpark Umhausen
1403.kurzbeschreibung: Greifvogelpark Umhausen in the Ötztal: 5,000 m² open-air arena by the Stuibenfall with 30 birds of prey, breathtaking flight shows, and falconry educational trail.

1404.name: Großglockner Hochalpenstraße
1404.kurzbeschreibung: The Grossglockner High Alpine Road is Austria's most iconic scenic highway, winding 48 km up to 2,571 m through the core of the Hohe Tauern National Park.

1405.name: Hahnenkamm
1405.kurzbeschreibung: Kitzbühel's Hahnenkamm is the legendary home of the downhill Streif race and a sunny panoramic hiking mountain in summer.

1406.name: Hahnenkamm Reutte
1406.kurzbeschreibung: The Hahnenkamm peak at 1,938 metres above Reutte in the Tannheim Mountains delights hikers with the Reutte gondola, sensory barefoot trails, and valley vistas.

1407.name: Haldensee
1407.kurzbeschreibung: Haldensee at 1,124 m in the Tannheimer Tal: crystal-clear mountain and bathing lake between Grän and Nesselwängle featuring the Wasserwelt Haldensee recreation centre.

1408.name: Hall in Tirol Altstadt
1408.kurzbeschreibung: The historic Altstadt of Hall in Tirol enchants as western Austria's largest old town, featuring Late Gothic alleys, Burg Hasegg, and the Münzerturm.

1409.name: Hechtsee
1409.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Hechtsee near Kufstein is a scenic alpine woodland swimming lake up to 57 m deep, nestled beneath the Thierberg ridge with a circular promenade and mountain vistas.

1410.name: Heimatmuseum Kufstein
1410.kurzbeschreibung: The Heimatmuseum Kufstein in the Bürgerturm of the fortress showcases historic bourgeois culture, guilds, the geology of the Kaisergebirge, and ancient weapons.

1411.name: Heiterwangsee
1411.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Heiterwanger See at 976 metres near Reutte is a fjord-like mountain lake featuring crystalline waters, historic passenger boats, and a canal connecting to Lake Plansee.

1412.name: Helblinghaus Innsbruck
1412.kurzbeschreibung: The Helblinghaus in Innsbruck's Altstadt: a 15th-century Late Gothic townhouse with a world-famous, opulent Rococo stucco facade created by Anton Gigl in 1732.

1413.name: Hintersteiner See
1413.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Hintersteiner See at 882 metres near Scheffau is celebrated as one of Tirol's cleanest alpine lakes, set in the Wilder Kaiser nature reserve with a panoramic circuit.

1414.name: Hintertuxer Gletscher
1414.kurzbeschreibung: Austria's only year-round ski resort offers 365 days of snow sports up to 3,250 m, the Nature Ice Palace, and Spannagel Cave.

1415.name: Hochgurgl
1415.kurzbeschreibung: High-altitude Hochgurgl (2,150 m) boasts snow security, the Top Mountain Crosspoint museum, and entry to the Timmelsjoch pass road.

1416.name: Hochstein
1416.kurzbeschreibung: Mount Hochstein (2,057 m) is Lienz's versatile local adventure mountain in East Tirol, featuring the Schlossbergbahn lifts, the Osttirodler alpine coaster, and Dolomite views.

1417.name: Hochzeiger Bergbahnen
1417.kurzbeschreibung: The Hochzeiger Bergbahnen in Jerzens in the Pitztal Valley access a family alpine paradise up to 2,560 m, home to the award-winning Stone Pine Park and mountain carts.

1418.name: Hofburg Innsbruck
1418.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserliche Hofburg Innsbruck enchants as a Habsburg residence featuring the magnificent Riesensaal, Empress Sisi apartments, and Rococo splendour.

1419.name: Hofkirche Innsbruck
1419.kurzbeschreibung: The Hofkirche Innsbruck houses Emperor Maximilian I's sumptuous tomb flanked by 28 larger-than-life 'Schwarze Mander' and the 1558 Ebert organ.

1420.name: Hohe Salve
1420.kurzbeschreibung: The Hohe Salve at 1,828 m in the Kitzb?heler Alpen: Tyrol's finest panoramic mountain featuring the Salvenkirchlein, a rotating terrace, and views of 70 three-thousanders.

1421.name: Ischgl
1421.kurzbeschreibung: World-renowned winter and summer lifestyle resort Ischgl in the Paznaun thrills with the Silvretta Arena, Idalp, and Ischgl Skyfly.

1422.name: Iseltal
1422.kurzbeschreibung: The Iseltal Valley in East Tirol is shaped by the Alps' last undammed glacial river, featuring dynamic gravel floodplains, dramatic side valleys, and the famed Iseltrail.

1423.name: Jakobskreuz Buchensteinwand
1423.kurzbeschreibung: The Jakobskreuz on the 1,456 m high Buchensteinwand in the Pillerseetal: at 30 m tall, the world's largest accessible summit cross featuring four viewing platforms.

1424.name: Kaiserbach Klamm
1424.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserbach-Klamm Gorge in the Kaiserbachtal near Kössen and Kirchdorf charms visitors with its cascading mountain brook and dramatic vistas of the Wilder Kaiser crags.

1425.name: Kaiserjägermuseum
1425.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserjägermuseum on Bergisel explores the history of the Tyrolean Kaiserjäger and forms an ensemble with Das Tirol Panorama and its 1,000 m² giant cyclorama.

1426.name: Tiroler Kaiserjägermuseum
1426.kurzbeschreibung: The Tiroler Kaiserjägermuseum on Bergisel in Innsbruck: founded in 1880, one of the world's oldest military museums chronicling the four k.u.k. Kaiserjäger regiments.

1427.name: Kaiserklamm
1427.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserklamm Gorge near Brandenberg is a wild ravine carved by the Brandenberger Ache, featuring cliff-hewn trails, rushing whitewaters, and timber-drifting heritage.

1428.name: Kalser Glocknerstraße
1428.kurzbeschreibung: The Kalser Glocknerstraße leads to the Lucknerhaus with the most impressive direct view of Austria's highest peak, the Großglockner (3,798 m).

1429.name: Karlskirche Volders
1429.kurzbeschreibung: The Karlskirche Volders near Hall in Tirol: unique oriental-style baroque church designed by Dr. Hippolyt Guarinoni from 1620–1654, featuring six domes and Knoller frescoes.

1430.name: Karwendelbahn
1430.kurzbeschreibung: The Karwendelbahn cable car ascends from Mittenwald to 2,244 m on the Karwendelspitze, featuring a giant telescope visitor centre, panoramic paths, and Dammkar vistas.

1431.name: Kaunertaler Gletscher
1431.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaunertal Glacier up to 3,108 m on the Weißseeferner ice sheet offers an alpine wonderland featuring the barrier-free Falginjochbahn lift, a walk-in ice crevasse, and tri-border vistas.

1432.name: Kaunertaler Gletscherstraße
1432.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaunertal Glacier Road is one of the Alps' premier high-altitude drives: 26 km, 29 hairpin turns, ascending from 1,287 m to 2,750 m past the turquoise Gepatsch Reservoir.

1433.name: Kisslinger Kristallglas Rattenberg
1433.kurzbeschreibung: The Kisslinger Kristallglas demonstration glassworks in Rattenberg: centuries-old glassblowing craftsmanship, cutting, engraving, and sparkling glass art.

1434.name: Kitzbüheler Altstadt
1434.kurzbeschreibung: The historic Altstadt von Kitzbühel delights with colourful townhouses in Inn-Salzach style, the Pfleggericht, and over 750 years of town history.

1435.name: Kitzbüheler Horn
1435.kurzbeschreibung: The Kitzbüheler Horn (1,996 m) is Kitzbühel's iconic panoramic mountain, celebrated for the KitzSki gondolas, the Alpine Flower Garden, and 360-degree vistas of the Wilder Kaiser.

1436.name: Wallfahrtskloster Maria Waldrast
1436.kurzbeschreibung: Maria Waldrast at 1,638 m at the foot of the Serles: Central Europe's highest monastery, a Servite pilgrimage site since 1407, and a legendary healing spring.

1437.name: Knappenwelt Gurgltal Tarrenz
1437.kurzbeschreibung: Knappenwelt Gurgltal in Tarrenz: an authentically reconstructed 15th-century mining village featuring ore processing and a healer's herb garden.

1438.name: Krippenmuseum Stamserhaus Wenns
1438.kurzbeschreibung: The Krippenmuseum in the historic Stamserhaus in Wenns: the oldest farmhouse in the Pitztal (15th century) featuring over 40 valuable Tyrolean nativity scenes.

1439.name: Krippenmuseum Wildermieming
1439.kurzbeschreibung: The Krippenmuseum in Wildermieming on the sunny plateau: over 50 artistic Tyrolean and oriental nativity scenes by master woodcarvers.

1440.name: Kundler Klamm
1440.kurzbeschreibung: Kundler Klamm connects the Wildschönau with the Inn Valley: a flat, accessible gorge trail along the Wildschönauer Ache featuring a stone turning workshop.

1441.name: Lanser See
1441.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Lanser See at 836 m on the Innsbruck plateau is a heritage peat-water bathing tarn featuring healing moor mud, a vintage lido, walking loops, and Nordkette views.

1442.name: Lechfall
1442.kurzbeschreibung: The Lechfall Waterfall at the threshold of the Lech Gorge near Füssen and Reutte features a twelve-metre cascade where the wild River Lech plunges into a narrow canyon.

1443.name: Lechweg
1443.kurzbeschreibung: The alpine opening section of the Lechweg on the Arlberg leads from Lake Formarinsee at 1,793 m beneath the Rote Wand through pristine gorges and Walser hamlets to Steeg.

1444.name: Lechweg Wanderweg
1444.kurzbeschreibung: The Lechweg through the Tyrolean Außerfern: long-distance trekking along the wild Lech river, across the 200 m Holzgau suspension bridge, to the Lechfall in Füssen.

1445.name: Leutascher Geisterklamm
1445.kurzbeschreibung: The Leutascher Geisterklamm: a spectacular rock gorge on the Bavarian border featuring a 970 m steel walkway, bold panoramic bridge, and goblin trail.

1446.name: Liebfrauenkirche Kitzbühel
1446.kurzbeschreibung: The Liebfrauenkirche Kitzbühel impresses with its 48 m fortified tower, the famous 6.4-tonne 'Kaiserglocke' from 1845, and masterly Baroque art.

1447.name: Lienzer Altstadt
1447.kurzbeschreibung: The historic old town of Lienz enchants as a sunny Dolomite town with Schloss Liebburg, a Mediterranean main square, and views of the Isel River.

1448.name: Lienzer Dolomiten
1448.kurzbeschreibung: The Lienzer Dolomiten soar up to 2,770 m: bold rock spires, Karlsbader Hütte at Lake Laserzsee, Dolomitenhütte, and climbing paradise.

1449.name: Localbahnmuseum Innsbruck (Tiroler Museumsbahnen)
1449.kurzbeschreibung: The Localbahnmuseum in the old Stubaitalbahnhof in Innsbruck: historic trams, locomotives, and Tyrolean railway heritage since 1891.

1450.name: Martinswand
1450.kurzbeschreibung: The nearly 700 m high Martinswand near Zirl: Emperor Maximilian legend, Maximiliansgrotte cave, and world-famous via ferratas above the Inn Valley.

1451.name: Mondscheinspitze
1451.kurzbeschreibung: The Mondscheinspitze (2,106 m) in the Karwendel: bold panoramic peak above Lake Achensee with Plumsjoch, ridge hike, and 360-degree summit views.

1452.name: Museum im Ballhaus Imst
1452.kurzbeschreibung: Museum im Ballhaus in Imst: historic 16th-century granary and bale storehouse showcasing Imst town history, sacred art, and the famous Schemenlaufen.

1453.name: Museumsfriedhof Kramsach
1453.kurzbeschreibung: The Museumsfriedhof Kramsach ('Lustiger Friedhof'): a unique open-air museum featuring whimsical, humorous epitaphs and five centuries of wrought-iron craftsmanship.

1454.name: Museum Grünes Haus
1454.kurzbeschreibung: The Museum Grünes Haus in Reutte: award-winning regional museum in a 16th-century townhouse with art of the Zeiller painters and Via Claudia Augusta.

1455.name: Museum Kitzbühel
1455.kurzbeschreibung: The Museum Kitzbühel in the historic Pfleggericht presents the world's largest collection of painter Alfons Walde, ski history, and a rooftop terrace.

1456.name: Museum St. Anton am Arlberg
1456.kurzbeschreibung: The Museum St. Anton am Arlberg in Trier-Haus: birthplace of alpine skiing, Hannes Schneider's Arlberg technique, and Arlberg railway history.

1457.name: Museum St. Johann in Tirol
1457.kurzbeschreibung: The Museum St. Johann in Tirol: regional history, alpinism on the Wilder Kaiser, Artothek gallery, and geology of the Kitzbüheler Alpen.

1458.name: Museum Tiroler Bauernhöfe
1458.kurzbeschreibung: Museum Tiroler Bauernhöfe in Kramsach: Tyrol's largest open-air museum featuring 14 original farmsteads and 37 outbuildings from all parts of Tyrol across 8 hectares.

1459.name: Museum der Wahrnehmung
1459.kurzbeschreibung: The interactive World of Senses in Sölden: sensory stations, optical phenomena, and high-alpine perceptions in the rear Ötztal.

1460.name: Muttekopf
1460.kurzbeschreibung: The Muttekopf (2,774 m) above Imst: Alpine Coaster, Imster Bergbahnen cable cars, cosy Muttekopfhütte at 1,934 m, and thrilling via ferratas.

1461.name: Nationalpark Hohe Tauern
1461.kurzbeschreibung: The Hohe Tauern National Park is the largest nature reserve in the Alps: Großglockner (3,798 m), pristine glaciers, golden eagles, and Matrei visitor centre.

1462.name: Nationalparkhaus Matrei
1462.kurzbeschreibung: The modern Nationalparkhaus in Matrei in Osttirol serves as the premier visitor hub for Hohe Tauern National Park, featuring interactive exhibits and guided ranger programs.

1463.name: Naturpark Kaunergrat
1463.kurzbeschreibung: Kaunergrat Nature Park spans rugged alpine valleys, mystical peat bogs, and the striking Gachenblick visitor centre overlooking the dramatic peaks of the Ötztal Alps.

1464.name: Naturpark Zillertaler Alpen
1464.kurzbeschreibung: The High Alps Nature Park Zillertaler Alpen protects an untamed wilderness of glaciers and peaks around the mountaineering village of Ginzling and the Berlin High Trail.

1465.name: Nauders Dreiländereck
1465.kurzbeschreibung: The Tripoint near Nauders on the Reschen Pass unites the borders of Austria, Italy, and Switzerland into a scenic alpine crossroads steeped in history and sweeping views.

1466.name: Nordkette
1466.kurzbeschreibung: Towering directly above Innsbruck, the Nordkette mountain range links urban culture with high-alpine Karwendel wilderness at the panoramic Hafelekar viewpoint.

1467.name: Notburga-Museum Eben am Achensee
1467.kurzbeschreibung: The Notburga-Museum in Eben am Achensee: the only museum honouring Tyrol's most beloved folk saint, Notburga von Rattenberg, housed in a Baroque vicarage since 2004.

1468.name: Obernberger See
1468.kurzbeschreibung: Obernberger See at 1,590 m in the Wipptal: emerald-green natural gem at the foot of the Tribulaun, featuring the baroque Seekapelle Maria am See on a peninsula.

1469.name: Ötzi Dorf
1469.kurzbeschreibung: Archaeological open-air park in Umhausen in the Ötztal valley, vividly reconstructing Neolithic life and culture during Ötzi the Iceman's era.

1470.name: Ötztaler Heimat- und Freilichtmuseum Längenfeld
1470.kurzbeschreibung: The Ötztaler Heimat- und Freilichtmuseum in Längenfeld-Lehn: 15 historic buildings from the 17th to the 20th century showcase alpine mountain farming culture.

1471.name: Ötztaler Höhenstraße
1471.kurzbeschreibung: The Ötztal Glacier Road above Sölden ascends into the high-alpine glaciated peaks of Rettenbach and Tiefenbach as one of Europe's highest panoramic alpine routes.

1472.name: Pass Thurn
1472.kurzbeschreibung: Pass Thurn at 1,274 metres elevation links Kitzbühel with the Salzburg Pinzgau region, boasting protected moorland reserves and magnificent High Tauern panoramas.

1473.name: Patscherkofel
1473.kurzbeschreibung: Patscherkofel rises proudly south of Innsbruck, combining Olympic winter sports history with the famed Stone Pine Trail (Zirbenweg) and sweeping valley vistas.

1474.name: Penken-Joch
1474.kurzbeschreibung: Penkenjoch at 2,095 metres above Mayrhofen blends outdoor adventure, the iconic rhomboid Garnet Chapel, and sweeping views of glaciated Zillertal summits.

1475.name: Pfarrkirche St. Andreas
1475.kurzbeschreibung: The Parish Church of St. Andrew in Kitzbühel impresses with Gothic hall architecture, sumptuous baroque sacred art, and its iconic pairing with the Liebfrauenkirche.

1476.name: Pfarrkirche St. Jakob am Arlberg
1476.kurzbeschreibung: The baroque Parish Church of St. James in St. Anton am Arlberg is the oldest sanctuary in the upper Stanzer Valley and a cherished station on the Way of St. James.

1477.name: Pfrillsee Kufstein
1477.kurzbeschreibung: Pfrillsee near Kufstein is the highest and warmest of Kufstein's four woodland lakes—a secluded moorland sanctuary with water lilies and peaceful loop trails.

1478.name: Piburger See
1478.kurzbeschreibung: Piburger See above Oetz is Tirol's warmest mountain bathing lake, set in an idyllic protected nature reserve framed by dense coniferous forest.

1479.name: Pillersee
1479.kurzbeschreibung: The Pillersee in St. Ulrich at 835 m altitude: emerald-green mountain lake in the Pillerseetal, circular trail, stand-up paddling, and backdrop of the Loferer Steinberge.

1480.name: Pitztaler Gletscher
1480.kurzbeschreibung: The Pitztal Glacier, celebrated as the 'Roof of Tirol', is Austria's highest glacier resort, featuring futuristic Café 3.440 and panoramas of the Wildspitze.

1481.name: Zeiss Planetarium Schwaz
1481.kurzbeschreibung: The Zeiss Planetarium in Schwaz: Western Austria's most modern fulldome dome cinema with digital star simulations and captivating journeys into space.

1482.name: Plansee
1482.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Plansee near Reutte is Tirol's second-largest lake—a fjord-like alpine wonderland boasting emerald water, scenic passenger cruises, and pebble beaches.

1483.name: Rundfunk- und Radiomuseum Innsbruck
1483.kurzbeschreibung: The Radiomuseum in Innsbruck: a fascinating journey through 100 years of broadcasting technology featuring over 400 operational historic radios and phonographs.

1484.name: Riedel Glas Manufaktur
1484.kurzbeschreibung: Riedel glassworks in Kufstein captivates visitors with the Sinnfonie sensory exhibition, traditional mouth-blown glass craftsmanship, and wine glass design.

1485.name: Riesenrundgemälde
1485.kurzbeschreibung: The Giant Cyclorama at the Tirol Panorama on Bergisel presents the dramatic 1809 Battles of Bergisel across 1,000 square metres of canvas in a 360-degree spectacle.

1486.name: Römermuseum Aguntum
1486.kurzbeschreibung: The archaeological park Aguntum near Lienz in East Tyrol brings to life the only ancient Roman town founded within the territory of modern Tyrol.

1487.name: Römerweg Kitzbühel
1487.kurzbeschreibung: The Roman Way (Römerweg) links Kitzbühel with St. Johann in Tirol, tracing an ancient trade path past historic heritage farmsteads with Kaiser mountain vistas.

1488.name: Rofanplateau
1488.kurzbeschreibung: The Rofan Plateau soaring above Lake Achensee is a high-alpine limestone paradise offering sheer lake drop-offs, the Eagle's Nest viewpoint, and ridge via ferratas.

1489.name: Rofanseilbahn
1489.kurzbeschreibung: The Rofanseilbahn cable car in Maurach at Lake Achensee reaches 1,840 m in the Rofan Mountains, featuring the AIRROFAN skyglider, the Adlerhorst viewing nest, and panoramic paths.

1490.name: Rosengartenschlucht
1490.kurzbeschreibung: The wild Rosengartenschlucht gorge in Imst enchants visitors with roaring waterfalls, wooden walkways, the Blue Grotto, and lush flora.

1491.name: Ruine Lavant
1491.kurzbeschreibung: The Kirchbichl hill in Lavant is one of the Eastern Alps' most important archaeological sites, featuring late-antique episcopal basilicas and sweeping views.

1492.name: Schlegeis-Staumauer & Stausee
1492.kurzbeschreibung: The Schlegeis-Staumauer dam at 1,782 m in upper Zillertal: 131 m high arch dam, dam interior tours, Flying Fox, and the ' Schlegeis131' via ferrata.

1493.name: Schlegeisspeicher
1493.kurzbeschreibung: Schlegeisspeicher in the upper Zillertal features turquoise waters, a monumental 131 m dam wall, and the famous Olpererhaus suspension bridge.

1494.name: Schloss Ambras
1494.kurzbeschreibung: Renaissance castle Ambras overlooking Innsbruck houses the world's oldest preserved museum collection and the magnificent Spanish Hall.

1495.name: Schloss Fernsteinsee
1495.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Fernsteinsee on the Fern Pass sits by an emerald mountain lake featuring the Sigmundsburg island fortress, boating, diving depths, and Mieming range vistas.

1496.name: Schloss Itter
1496.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Itter perches on a rocky ridge in the Brixental: origins around 1240, dramatic battle of 1945, and widely visible monument.

1497.name: Schloss Lengberg
1497.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Lengberg in Nikolsdorf (Osttirol): monumental 12th-century Renaissance fortress on a dolomite rock, renowned for late medieval bra discoveries.

1498.name: Schloss Lichtenwerth
1498.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Lichtenwerth in Münster: North Tyrol's only preserved late-Romanesque moated castle from the 12th century, idyllically surrounded by reed ponds along the Inn.

1499.name: Schloss Matzen
1499.kurzbeschreibung: Picturesque castle near Reith in the Alpbachtal, surrounded by the heritage-listed 15-hectare Matzen Park with tranquil ponds and exotic trees.

1500.name: Schloss Mentlberg
1500.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Mentlberg on the southern slope of Innsbruck: a fairytale Late Historicist residence in the style of Loire châteaux, redesigned in 1890 by Heinrich von Bourbon.

1501.name: Schloss Rotholz Buch in Tirol
1501.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Rotholz in Buch in Tirol: stately 1575 Renaissance hunting lodge built by Archduke Ferdinand II, today the cradle of Tyrolean alpine cheese making.

1502.name: Schloss Starkenberg
1502.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Starkenberg near Tarrenz: built in 1310, historic Starkenberger Fehde, BierMythos adventure tour and castle brewery since 1810.

1503.name: Schloss Tratzberg
1503.kurzbeschreibung: Stately Renaissance castle perched above the Inn Valley featuring original state rooms, historic armouries, and award-winning audio drama tours.

1504.name: Schloss Weiherburg
1504.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Weiherburg above Innsbruck: a Late Gothic noble manor from 1460, menagerie of Archduke Ferdinand II, St. Anne's castle chapel, and panoramic views of the city.

1505.name: Schwarzsee Kitzbühel
1505.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Schwarzsee near Kitzbühel is a scenic peat-water tarn at 762 m, known as one of the warmest alpine bathing lakes with boat hires, lido, and Wilder Kaiser reflections.

1506.name: Seespitz Achenkirch
1506.kurzbeschreibung: Seespitz Achenkirch on Lake Achensee's northern shore features a sandy bathing lido, shallow swim lagoon, ferry landings, and scenic vistas of Rofan and Karwendel.

1507.name: Silberbergwerk Schwaz
1507.kurzbeschreibung: The historic silver mine in Schwaz takes visitors deep underground on an authentic mine train into the heart of medieval Europe's mining capital.

1508.name: Silvretta Hochalpenstraße
1508.kurzbeschreibung: The Silvretta High Alpine Road negotiates 34 hairpin bends linking Tyrol and Vorarlberg, reaching the 2,037 m Bielerhöhe pass, Lake Silvretta, and Mount Piz Buin views.

1509.name: Sommer-Funpark Fiss
1509.kurzbeschreibung: Sommer-Funpark Fiss at 1,812 m Möseralm: alpine action adventure world featuring Fisser Flitzer, Fisser Flieger, Skyswing, and giant slides.

1510.name: Spieljoch
1510.kurzbeschreibung: Spieljoch in Fügen is the premier adventure peak in the Zillertal with a 10-seater gondola to 1,865 m, water adventure park, historic copper mine, and panoramas.

1511.name: St. Anton am Arlberg
1511.kurzbeschreibung: St. Anton am Arlberg is the world-renowned cradle of alpine skiing, captivating summer visitors with the Valluga cable car, via ferratas, and Verwall valley.

1512.name: Stadtturm Innsbruck
1512.kurzbeschreibung: The 51-metre-high Stadtturm in Innsbruck's Old Town: built in 1450, 133 steps to the viewing platform, watchman history, and onion dome.

1513.name: Stausee Zillergründl
1513.kurzbeschreibung: The fjord-like Speicher Zillergründl (1,850 m) in the Zillertal Alps features an imposing 186 m arch dam and the scenic trail to Little Tibet.

1514.name: Steinbockzentrum Tirol St. Leonhard
1514.kurzbeschreibung: The Steinbockzentrum Tirol at Schrofenhof in St. Leonhard im Pitztal: Alpine ibex wildlife enclosure, modern architecture, and the story of resettlement.

1515.name: Stift Stams
1515.kurzbeschreibung: Cistercian abbey Stift Stams in the Oberinntal: founded in 1273, featuring a baroque abbey basilica, burial vault of the Tyrolean sovereigns, Bernardisaal, and monastery museum.

1516.name: Stift Wilten
1516.kurzbeschreibung: Historic Wilten Abbey in Innsbruck impresses as a spiritual centre with sumptuous baroque architecture, monastery traditions, and the famed Wilten Boys' Choir.

1517.name: Streif & Hahnenkamm-Stadion
1517.kurzbeschreibung: The legendary Streif in Kitzbühel is the world's most spectacular downhill ski course, accessible in summer via an interactive themed hiking trail.

1518.name: Grawa-Wasserfall
1518.kurzbeschreibung: The Grawa Waterfall in the Stubai Valley is the Eastern Alps' widest cascade at 85 m, dropping 180 m with an alpine health lounger observatory.

1519.name: Stuibenfälle im Außerfern
1519.kurzbeschreibung: The Stuibenfälle Waterfalls near Reutte and Breitenwang are dramatic tiered cascades of the Archbach river featuring suspension bridges, belvederes, and trails linking to Lake Plansee.

1520.name: Stuibenfall Umhausen
1520.kurzbeschreibung: Dropping 159 m near Umhausen in the Ötztal, Stuibenfall is Tyrol's highest waterfall, accessed via suspension bridges, 700 steps, and a via ferrata.

1521.name: Swarovski Kristallwelten
1521.kurzbeschreibung: Swarovski Crystal Worlds in Wattens dazzles visitors with 18 subterranean chambers of wonder and expansive landscaped gardens featuring a sparkling crystal cloud.

1522.name: Tannheimer Tal
1522.kurzbeschreibung: The Tannheimer Tal at 1,100 m in the Allgäu Alps is hailed as Europe's most enchanting high valley, featuring Lake Vilsalpsee, Haldensee, cable cars, and limestone peaks.

1523.name: Ruine Thierberg & Aussichtswarte
1523.kurzbeschreibung: The Thierberg, with its castle ruins and viewing tower, offers a fantastic view over Kufstein and the Inntal.

1524.name: Tiefenbachklamm
1524.kurzbeschreibung: Tiefenbachklamm between Brandenberg and Kramsach: spectacular 4 km gorge trail along the Brandenberger Ache with viewing platform and timber floating history.

1525.name: Tiroler Bienenwelt Schönwies
1525.kurzbeschreibung: Tiroler Bienenwelt in Schönwies: an interactive 1,000 m² beekeeping museum with observation beehives, honey tastings, and a show distillery.

1526.name: 1. Tiroler Holzmuseum Auffach
1526.kurzbeschreibung: The 1. Tiroler Holzmuseum in Auffach (Wildschönau): over 3,000 carved wooden exhibits in the birthplace of woodcarver Hubert Salcher.

1527.name: Tiroler Landesmuseum Ferdinandeum
1527.kurzbeschreibung: The Tyrolean State Museum Ferdinandeum in Innsbruck showcases celebrated collections spanning from the Stone Age to contemporary art.

1528.name: Tiroler Schnapsmuseum Pill
1528.kurzbeschreibung: The Tiroler Schnapsmuseum in Pill near Schwaz: historic Plankenhof palace distillery with copper stills and tastings of fine fruit brandies.

1529.name: Tiroler Volkskunstmuseum
1529.kurzbeschreibung: The Tiroler Volkskunstmuseum beside the Hofkirche is considered Europe's finest folk art museum: authentic wooden parlours, traditional costumes, and carnival masks.

1530.name: Trattenbachtal & Trattenbachalm
1530.kurzbeschreibung: The Trattenbachtal in the Kitzbühel Alps is a tranquil alpine valley in the Hohe Salve region featuring traditional dairy pastures, clear mountain streams, and Kröndlhorn views.

1531.name: Triassic Park Steinplatte
1531.kurzbeschreibung: Triassic Park on the 1,700 m high Steinplatte in Waidring: prehistoric petrified coral sea, dinosaur models, Triassic Beach, and stalactite cave.

1532.name: Trisannabrücke
1532.kurzbeschreibung: Spectacular 87-metre-high railway arch bridge of the Arlbergbahn spanning the Trisanna gorge near Pians, crowned by medieval Schloss Wiesberg.

1533.name: Tristacher See
1533.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Tristacher See near Lienz is East Tyrol's sole natural bathing lake at 821 m beneath the Lienz Dolomites, featuring a public lido, woodland loop, and dining.

1534.name: Triumphpforte Innsbruck
1534.kurzbeschreibung: The Baroque Triumphpforte in Innsbruck: erected in 1765 by Empress Maria Theresia, it celebrates the wedding of her son Leopold and mourns Emperor Franz I.

1535.name: Untere Isar & Karwendelschlucht
1535.kurzbeschreibung: The pristine Untere Isarklamm (Gleirschklamm) near Scharnitz enchants hikers with emerald pools and a dramatic, wild gorge in the Karwendel.

1536.name: Venet & Venetbahn
1536.kurzbeschreibung: Mount Venet (2,208 m Krahberg) above Landeck/Zams offers 360-degree panoramas of over 80 alpine peaks, Tyrol’s highest observatory, and Tobi’s adventure trail.

1537.name: Vilsalpsee
1537.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Vilsalpsee at 1,165 m in the Tannheimer Tal is an emerald alpine jewel cradled in a pristine nature reserve beneath Gaishorn peak, with waterside trails and rustic pastures.

1538.name: Virgental & Umbalfälle
1538.kurzbeschreibung: The sun-kissed Virgental valley in East Tyrol is a pristine alpine valley in the Hohe Tauern National Park, home to the thunderous Umbal Waterfalls.

1539.name: Tiroler Steinöl Vitalberg Pertisau
1539.kurzbeschreibung: The Vitalberg Tyrolean Shale Oil Museum in Pertisau on Lake Achensee: futuristic glass mountain showcasing the history of Alpine 'Black Gold' since 1902.

1540.name: Vitalpinum Thal-Assling
1540.kurzbeschreibung: The Vitalpinum in Thal-Assling (Osttirol): 7,000 m² Alpine wellness park with a historic mountain pine oil distillery, barefoot path, and herb garden.

1541.name: Wallfahrtsbasilika St. Michael
1541.kurzbeschreibung: The Pilgrimage Basilica of St. Michael in Absam is Tyrol's premier Marian shrine, renowned for its rococo decor and the miraculous Marian apparition icon.

1542.name: Wallfahrtskirche Kalvarienberg
1542.kurzbeschreibung: The baroque pilgrimage church Wallfahrtskirche Kalvarienberg in Imst offers a contemplative Stations of the Cross, magnificent frescoes, and wide panoramic views.

1543.name: Wallfahrtskirche Maria Thal
1543.kurzbeschreibung: The baroque pilgrimage church Wallfahrtskirche Maria Thal near Kufstein enchants at the forest edge with a late Gothic miraculous image, ex-voto tablets, and profound peace.

1544.name: Wallfahrtsort St. Georgenberg
1544.kurzbeschreibung: St. Georgenberg near Stans: Tyrol's oldest pilgrimage site perched on an 898-metre cliff top, featuring the spectacular Hohe Brücke and rock monastery dating from 950.

1545.name: Wallfahrtsort Mariastein
1545.kurzbeschreibung: The pilgrimage site of Mariastein in Kufsteinerland: a Gothic tower castle on a 14 m rock cone, 150 steps to the Chapel of Grace and guardian of the 1602 Tyrolean Archducal Hat.

1546.name: Walschensaal
1546.kurzbeschreibung: The mystical Walschensaal in the Tux Valley is a protected geological rock cavity and a peaceful sanctuary set within alpine forests.

1547.name: Wilder Kaiser & Kaiserbachtal
1547.kurzbeschreibung: The iconic Wilder Kaiser mountain range captivates with rugged limestone peaks, via ferratas, panoramic trails, and famous Bergdoktor film sets.

1548.name: Wolfsklamm
1548.kurzbeschreibung: Wolfsklamm in Stans is regarded as the pearl of the Tyrolean Unterland: 354 wooden steps over roaring cascades up to the cliff monastery St. Georgenberg.

1549.name: Wunderkammer Elbigenalp
1549.kurzbeschreibung: The Wunderkammer in Elbigenalp: award-winning museum in the birthplace of the Geierwally dedicated to Johann Anton Falger, Lechtal lithography, and alpine history.

1550.name: Zahmer Kaiser & Kaisertal
1550.kurzbeschreibung: The Zahme Kaiser, with its gentle peaks and vast alpine meadows, is an ideal hiking area for families and food-loving walkers.

1551.name: Zammer Lochputz
1551.kurzbeschreibung: Zammer Lochputz near Landeck: Tirol's mystical gorge with 30 m high Lötzer Wasserfall, historic 1923 hydroelectric power station, Spiegelturm and suspension bridge.

1552.name: Zettersfeld Sonnenbalkon Lienz
1552.kurzbeschreibung: The sun-drenched Zettersfeld above Lienz features magnificent vistas of the Lienz Dolomites, family-friendly alpine paths, and high mountain hikes to the Neualplseen.

1553.name: Zeughaus Innsbruck
1553.kurzbeschreibung: Built around 1500 by Emperor Maximilian I, the Zeughaus in Innsbruck showcases Tyrolean cultural history within its imposing Renaissance quadrangle.

1554.name: Zillertaler Höhenstraße
1554.kurzbeschreibung: The Zillertaler Höhenstraße is a 42 km scenic drive offering breathtaking views of the Zillertaler Alpen and their glaciers.

1555.name: Zillertaler Museumsbahn
1555.kurzbeschreibung: The historic Zillertal steam railway has linked Jenbach and Mayrhofen since 1902 with nostalgic locomotives, open-air carriages, and a Swarovski crystal carriage.

1556.name: Zirbenweg Patscherkofel & Glungezer
1556.kurzbeschreibung: The highest Zirbenlehrpfad in the Alps on the Patscherkofel – a dream hike through fragrant Zirbenwälder, with breathtaking panoramic views.

1557.name: Tiroler Zugspitzbahn & Zugspitze
